prompt:

An uncanny, shiny early-CGI floating shape with an unnerving face intrudes from the dark ceiling, rendered conspicuously differently from the flat drawn characters.

No text, letters, captions, signatures, logos or watermarks. No reference images.

A huge blue summer sky, saturated fresh green grass, bright playful invention colors, strong flat sunny graphic staging. Keep the giant looping invention readable across the whole frame.
